title: Top 10 languages on GitHub and their top 10 frameworks

language_ranking.source: GitHub Octoverse 2025 - top languages by distinct monthly contributors (August 2025)

framework_ranking.basis: Ordered by ecosystem prominence (GitHub stars, package-registry downloads and production usage as of 2026). Ordering is a judgement call, not a single published metric.
framework_ranking.note: Only frameworks/major libraries are listed - languages, runtimes and package managers are excluded.

scaffolds.covers: the top 10 frameworks of the top 10 languages: 95 starter projects (5 cannot run in a Linux container: WPF, .NET MAUI, Unity, Unreal Engine, Godot), plus two of the fleet's own TypeScript starters: the full-stack fleet-scaffold-v1 and the Next.js Admin dashboard
scaffolds.state: files only - no dependencies installed, nothing built or run
